description: Short real-run smoke for 27_ibot (iBOT, Zhou et al. 2021): pretrain -> encoder.pt (the teacher ViT backbone) -> linear_eval, one epoch on tiny real-shaped ImageFolder data. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3); the spec lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method. 27_ibot is one of the methods whose trainer previously called dist.init_process_group(backend='nccl') the moment LOCAL_RANK was present, so it could not run on the single-process local backend (bin/launch.py exports WORLD_SIZE=1/RANK=0/LOCAL_RANK=0 but no MASTER_ADDR): the fix gates the distributed setup on WORLD_SIZE>1 in setup_dist() (train_pretrain.py), matching the repo device invariant (docs/GPU.md) and the single-process shape every other CPU-verified method already uses. Only pretrain stood up a process group; evaluate_linear.py never did. The config is nested (model/data/ibot/training); following the method's own test (tests/test_method_27_ibot.py), the ViT-Small backbone (embed_dim 384) is kept but its crops and heads are shrunk: global/local crop 224/96 -> 32/16, n_local_crops 10 -> 1, DINO/iBOT head out_dim 8192 -> 64, head_hidden_dim 2048 -> 64, head_bottleneck_dim 256 -> 32, head_nlayers 3 -> 1, teacher temps and their warmup relaxed, and the checkpoint-health band widened (a one-step random model's loss falls outside the real-training band, so fail_fast must not trip). One epoch, batch_size 2. linear_eval reads the same ViT-Small teacher (its positional embedding interpolates from the tiny pretrain grid), one epoch, batch_size 2. Both stages import torch.utils.tensorboard (SummaryWriter), so needs lists tensorboard; a venv without it gate-skips this spec, which is then verified under the method's own .venvs/27_ibot (the 38_clip pattern).
